name: Gridicons
about: Gridicons is a free, open-source icon set with 207 icons designed by Automattic. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under GPL 2.0.

faqs.a: Yes. All 207 Gridicons are open source under the GPL 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the GPL 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Gridicons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 207 icons in the Gridicons set, designed by Automattic. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Gridicons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Gridicons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
